brief: docs/m7f-brief.md, addendum 2 item 3 (post hoc, descriptive; part-2 verdicts unchanged)

brain.input: k*loom_L on every left LC4+LPLC2 cell, k*loom_R on the right (no heterogeneity, ASSUMPTION)
brain.readout: DNp01 L/R spikes in the last 300 ms (escape profile)
brain.warmup: 5000 steps with no input after the reset; game clock 0 = end of warm-up; warm-up spikes not used

decoder.rule: count GF spikes per side in [now - window_ms, now); both >= n -> JUMP; left only -> RIGHT; right only -> LEFT; neither -> NOOP
decoder.now_ms: end of the current tick (game clock)

yoked_agent.wrap: from the start of the tape when the game outlasts it

rules.matrix: rows = tape seed (the fly's evaluation game), columns = game seed, both in evaluation seed order; the diagonal must equal the fly's scores
rules.yoked_score: game seed j: mean of the nine tapes i != j on game j
rules.paired: fly j - yoked j, mean > 3 SEM (M7c rule)

reading.beat: the score came from when the fly moved, given what it saw
reading.indistinguishable: the movement pattern alone explains it

rules.tape: digits per tick, 0 NOOP 1 JUMP 2 LEFT 3 RIGHT
rules.replay_check: seed, score, ticks and action counts equal part 2's evaluation games
